🔄 I'd swap Triceps Pushdown for Low-to-High Cable Fly. It's a chest isolation move with very little elbow bend, so it should be easier on the joint. Tap Swap on the card to make the change.

The other triceps options in the library, Dips and Overhead Triceps Extension, load the elbow more, so I'd skip them today.

⚠️ Keep the load light and stay pain-free. If the elbow hurts during bench or overhead press, drop the weight or skip them. If the pain is sharp or sticks around, stop and get it checked by a professional.
